title: Classic Wonders of Japan | Group Tour Package
highlights: From Tokyo's urban experiences to Nikko's reflective memorials, spend a memorable time in Japan, offering a blend of rich heritage and modernity.
Marvel at the Uzu no Michi Bridge, renowned for its views of the Naruto Whirlpools, one of the world's largest tidal whirlpools created by powerful currents.
Stroll through the bustling streets of Shinjuku, famous for its vibrant nightlife and dynamic entertainment scenes, including countless bars, clubs, and theatres.
Explore the well-preserved interior of Crow Castle in Matsumoto, featuring historical exhibits and artefacts that offer a glimpse into Japan's feudal era.
Admire Yomeimon Gate, showcasing over 500 carvings depicting mythical creatures, as you visit Nikko Toshogu Shrine, one of the major shrines in Nikko.
inclusions: Transfer from Narita International Airport to Shinagawa Prince Hotel

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Tokyo | Leisure Time at Shinjuku District
days.desc: Welcome to Tokyo, Japan's vibrant capital! Upon arrival at the airport, you'll be transferred to your hotel. After checking in, relax till noon. Later, in the evening, you'll be driven to Tokyo Station to take the metro to Shinjuku District (fare included). Explore Shinjuku at your own pace, visiting iconic spots like Golden Gai, renowned for its lively nightlife, and Shinjuku Gyoen Park, famous for its serene beauty. afterwards, you'll be transferred back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Tokyo Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: In the morning, board the transfer from the hotel for Tokyo sightseeing tour. During this exploration, enjoy a visit to Zojoji Temple, famed for its views of Tokyo Tower. Next, you'll be driven to Shibuya Crossing, one of Japan's busiest intersections. Continue your journey through Omotesando to admire the beautiful Imperial Palace and Nijubashi Bridge. Conclude the day with a visit to Akihabara, followed by a stop to Nakamise Street. Later, get driven back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Hiroshima | Hiroshima Walking Tour | Visit to Miyajima Island
days.desc: After checking out from the hotel, get driven to Tokyo Station to take the bullet train to Hiroshima (fare included). Upon arrival, get driven to the hotel for check in. After relaxing for some time, get ready for a walking tour of Hiroshima, covering the Peace Memorial Museum and Park, and Atomic Bomb Dome. Next, board the ferry from Hiroshima Port to Miyajima Island. On arrival, explore Itsukushima Shrine and its stunning torii gates. Later, get driven back to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Matsuyama | En-route Visit to Matsuyama Castle, Ishiteji Temple & Dogo Onsen
days.desc: After checking out from the hotel, board the transfer to Hiroshima Port for a ferry ride to Matsuyama on Shikoku Island. Upon arrival, you'll be driven to Shinonome-gucci Station to board the cable car to Matsuyama Castle, known for its stunning architecture. Next, visit Ishiteji Temple, an esteemed shrine in the city. End the day with a relaxing visit to Dogo Onsen, where you can unwind and relax in a hot bath. Later, get transferred to the hotel and check in for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Kobe | En-route Kotohira Shrine, Ritsurin Garden & Uzu no Michi Bridge Visit
days.desc: After checking out from the hotel, you'll be driven to Mt. Zozu to marvel at the beauty of Kotohira Shrine. Next, you'll be transferred to Takamatsu, where you can explore the beautiful Ritsurin Garden, famed for its serene atmosphere. Continue your journey to Kobe, passing the iconic Naruto Bridge. Here, you’ll have the chance to walk on the Uzu No Michi glass walkway, offering views of the whirlpools below. Continue towards Kobe and after reaching, check in at the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Kobe Earthquake Museum Visit | Transfer to Mt. Koya | Mt. Koya Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Start your day by checking out from the hotel and getting transferred to Kobe's Earthquake Memorial Museum, providing insight into the devastating earthquake. Next, you'll be driven to Mt. Koya, one of Japan's most sacred mountains. Upon arrival, visit Okuno Mausoleum, home to over 200 graves, and explore the historic Kongobuji Temple, the head temple of the Shingon Sect. Later, you'll be taken to a Buddhist monastery where you can experience Zen meditation and settle in for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Kyoto | Kyoto Sightseeing Tour | Leisure Time at Gion District
days.desc: In the morning, depart from the monastery and board your transfer to Kyoto. Upon arrival, check in at your hotel and take some time to relax. Later, get ready for Kyoto sightseeing tour, beginning by exploring Fushimi Inari Shrine, known for its stunning torii gates, and Kinkakuji Temple, famous for its golden pavilion. Then, you'll be driven to Gion district, where you can enjoy some leisurely time. Afterwards, make your way back to the hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Nagano | Leisure Time in Tsumago | Crow Castle Visit
days.desc: Prepare to check out from the hotel and board the transfer to Nagano. En route, make a stop at Tsumago, where you can explore Tsumago Castle, known for its ancient ruins or enjoy a leisurely walk along the scenic Nakasendo Trail on your own. Next, continue to Matsumoto to visit the impressive Crow Castle, famed for its intricate architecture and historic courtyards. Continue the journey to Nagano. Upon arrival, check in at your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Transfer to Ikaho | En-route Zenkoji Temple & Monkey Park Visit | Leisure Time at Kusatsu
days.desc: After checking out from the hotel, you'll be transferred to Nagano. Upon arrival, visit Zenkoji Temple, renowned for its ancient Buddhist statues and take part in the Gomakuyo ceremony, known to bring good fortune. Next, head to Monkey Park to see snow monkeys in their natural habitat. Continue your journey to Kusatsu, where you can explore at your own pace and enjoy the local charm. Finally, proceed to Ikaho. Upon arrival, check in at a traditional Ryokan-style hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Nikko Sightseeing Tour | Departure from Tokyo
days.desc: In the morning, check out from your hotel and get transferred to Nikko. Upon arrival, enjoy a sightseeing tour of the city, covering Toshogu Shrine, known for its Crying Dragon painting and intricate carvings. Next, explore the Iemitsu Mausoleum, an important historical site. Stroll through the Kanmangafuchi Abyss, a serene gorge formed by the eruption of Mt. Nantai. After a day of exploration, you'll be driven to Tokyo. Upon arrival, head to the airport on your own for your flight back home.
